# Vendored third-party files

Reference originals from other repositories, kept here for provenance and so the Rust ports in `src/` can be audited against them.

- `llama-cpp/` — MIT — JSON GBNF grammar for constrained output
- `openclaw/` — MIT — tool-result budgets, truncation, UTF-8 boundaries, repeat guard
- `terminal-bench/` — Apache-2.0 — eval task template

See [`../docs/REUSE_REGISTER.md`](../docs/REUSE_REGISTER.md) for source URLs, licenses, justifications, and adaptation rules. These TypeScript files are **not** compiled into tinyloop; the Rust ports are.
